_: (#R540) Atlas' attachment picker was rebuilt: it now takes PDFs and office documents beside images and plain text, so the ＋ button's title, the two per-message limits and six new refusal toasts are new strings in js/atlas-console.js. de/ru/es are the arguments already written at the L(…) call sites and are copied here verbatim; fr, ko and zh-Hant are the new work. ⚠ «That file is too large» and «Those documents are too large to send together» are followed at run time by a byte size the app appends — ' (8.0 MB)' / ' (12.0 MB)' — so NEITHER may end in a full stop or a bracket in any language. ⚠ File extensions (.doc/.xls/.ppt/.docx/.xlsx/.pptx) and the format name PDF are product names and stay Latin in every language. ⚠ zh-Hant keeps IntMap's own distinction — 檔案 is a file (as in the existing 'Attach a file' → 附加檔案) and 文檔 is a document — NOT 文件, which the existing vision prompt at ui.zh.js:1711 uses, because scripts/zh-hans.mjs maps 檔案→文件 and the mainland reader would otherwise be told to «attach a 文件 (image, PDF, 文件 or text)»; 文檔→文档 is the mainland word and stays distinct; Columns: de, ru, es, fr, ko, zh-Hant.
